cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: The Plan Gets Better
cards.instruction: Celebrate every setback as proof that the scheme is becoming more sophisticated, selective, or impossible to detect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the six people who solved our supper-club invitation. An admirably selective table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Five thought it was a puzzle night. May I remove their places? They've cancelled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Approved. Wonderful filtering; only a truly committed diner remains.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the printer. He wants his money. Shall I send him away?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly not. I authorize a private partnership dinner. Seat him beside me; the scheme has selected someone with a real investment in our evening.

reason: Use B's actual seating and dismissal requests to let A authorize the increasingly selective reinterpretation and act on the final creditor revelation.
